set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=33631a9dd609737f7219c50138e92a46385ae666; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage12c/stage12c_tolerance_sweep.py > /tmp/growbox-stage12c-first-action.py; python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/tmp/growbox-stage12c-first-action.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = 'TOLERANCES = (0.0, 0.001, 0.0025, 0.005)'
new = 'TOLERANCES = (0.001, 0.0015, 0.002)'
assert old in text
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
old = '        selected_delta_u = _plan_delta_u(selected_plan, simulator.previous_command)\n        evaluations = result.evaluations'
new = '        selected_delta_u = _plan_delta_u(selected_plan, simulator.previous_command)\n        selected_first_delta = _plan_delta_u((selected_plan[0],), simulator.previous_command)\n        evaluations = result.evaluations'
assert old in text
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
old = '''                    delta_u = _plan_delta_u(candidate_plan, simulator.previous_command)
                    if delta_u < selected_delta_u - 1.0e-12 or (
                        abs(delta_u - selected_delta_u) <= 1.0e-12
                        and secondary < selected_secondary - 1.0e-12
                    ):
                        selected_plan = candidate_plan
                        selected_tracking = tracking
                        selected_secondary = secondary
                        selected_delta_u = delta_u
'''
new = '''                    first_delta = _plan_delta_u((candidate_plan[0],), simulator.previous_command)
                    delta_u = _plan_delta_u(candidate_plan, simulator.previous_command)
                    if (
                        first_delta < selected_first_delta - 1.0e-12
                        or (
                            abs(first_delta - selected_first_delta) <= 1.0e-12
                            and delta_u < selected_delta_u - 1.0e-12
                        )
                        or (
                            abs(first_delta - selected_first_delta) <= 1.0e-12
                            and abs(delta_u - selected_delta_u) <= 1.0e-12
                            and secondary < selected_secondary - 1.0e-12
                        )
                    ):
                        selected_plan = candidate_plan
                        selected_tracking = tracking
                        selected_secondary = secondary
                        selected_delta_u = delta_u
                        selected_first_delta = first_delta
'''
assert old in text
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
text = text.replace('stage12c_relative_tracking_tolerance_sweep', 'stage12c_first_action_smoothing_sweep', 1)
path.write_text(text)
PY
